author: Albert Mulder
releaseNotes:
0.1.1 - Fixed a repeat in-stock alert after the first Done on a new item and repeated alerts when a notification device fails; 'possibly in stock' is now opt-in; an unreadable price no longer counts as under your max; better variant, SKU, price and entity parsing; the test button no longer turns on switches; debug logging defaults off with 30-minute auto-off; large lists always fit the polling interval; the daily run no longer doubles up with the regular check; in stock with an unreadable price neither alerts nor resets; stable variant choice; 1.299 and 1 299,00 read as thousands. UPGRADING: re-check max prices auto-filled from decimal-comma prices (e.g. 1.299 from 1.299,00); 'possibly in stock' no longer alerts unless turned on per item; open the main app and press Done once.
0.1.0 - Initial release: watch store products (stock & price) or any web page (text appears/disappears), per-item notifications and messages, verify-and-autofill, price-drop alerts, daily and per-item in-stock reminders.
